item.title: Fundamentals #0072: Shopify: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
Shopify (SHOP) revenue in Q3 was 3.74 billion USD (+31.6% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased by 80.0% y/y to 0.36 USD.

Quarterly results

The company’s operating income reached 568.00 million USD (+65.6% y/y), while net income was 462.00 million USD (+75.0% y/y).

Management commentary

Management emphasized that personal AI agents represent an entirely new sales channel that allows merchants to acquire new customers. According to management, purchases made by AI agents are in the early stages, but their growth rate is clearly strong. Management noted that when a customer reaches a store via an AI agent, the company’s earnings remain the same as with other methods of reaching a customer. According to management, despite the shift in marketing and infrastructure spending over time, nothing has fundamentally changed in the company’s costs and profitability. Management also indicated that the purchase of the shop.com domain is a declaration of more ambitious plans for the Shop app as a shopping destination. According to management, brick-and-mortar sales do not constitute a separate business, but are based on the same platform, catalog, and buyer relationships.

item.title: Fundamentals #0065: Booking: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
Booking (BKNG) revenue in the third quarter was 8.89 billion USD (−1.3% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) increased by 6.8% y/y to 3.61 USD.

Quarterly results

Earnings per share (adjusted) reached 4.66 USD (+17.1% y/y), while operating income was 3.42 billion USD (−1.9% y/y). The company’s net income was 2.72 billion USD (−1.1% y/y).

What management says

Management emphasized that the traffic generated by AI tools is currently small, but the company is capturing most of this traffic, which, given the current dynamics, is an early stage. According to management, collaboration with AI agent creators aims to build economic advantage by diversifying traffic sources. Management noted that in some regions, especially in Europe, regulations may slow the adoption of personal AI agents. According to management, small and medium-sized hotels can count on the company’s support, as fees are only collected after the guest’s arrival. Management also stated that preliminary bookings for next year look healthy, giving the company confidence in its outlook.

item.title: Fundamentals #0063: Apple: 4Q2026 results
item.description:
Apple (AAPL) revenue in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 was 114.48 billion USD (+11.7% year over year), and earnings per share (accounting) increased by 13.5% year over year to 2.10 USD.

Quarterly results

Earnings per share (accounting, basic) was 2.11 USD (+14.1% year over year), with operating income at 35.63 billion USD (+9.9% year over year).

What management says

Management emphasized that Siri AI serves as an assistant whose capabilities will be gradually expanded while maintaining an emphasis on privacy and security. According to management, the iPhone is set to become the user’s intelligent personal hub, as it stores the most important data to which even the company does not have access. Management is optimistic about long-term services growth, pointing to the growing number of active devices as the foundation of this process. According to management, rising memory prices are putting pressure on product prices, making programs that facilitate customer purchases important. Management also noted that in subsequent quarters, the benefit from cheaper inventory will decrease in the face of unprecedented memory prices. According to management, production of the new iPhone Duo is growing, however, it is currently difficult to predict when supply will meet demand.

item.title: Fundamentals #0062: Vertex Pharmaceuticals: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) revenue in Q3 increased by 11.8% year over year to 3.44 billion USD, while earnings per share (GAAP, basic) fell by 39.1% year over year to 2.58 USD.

Company guidance

For the full year 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 13.15 billion USD – 13.25 billion USD, including “PALSONIFY” sales revenue at a level of 40.00 million USD – 50.00 million USD.

Management commentary

Management emphasized that contacts with the US regulator regarding povetacept are proceeding as planned and the company is awaiting a decision date. According to management, povetacept has been manufactured by the same manufacturer since the beginning of the studies, which allows for a calm assessment of the application and production issues. Management also pointed to interest from nephrologists in povetacept and the desire to use it once it is approved for marketing. According to management, acting on the cause of kidney disease ensures better effects, which increases confidence in the results of anaxaplin. Management noted that in the case of the pain medication JOURNAVX, it is consciously maintaining a patient support program to acclimate physicians to new habits until full reimbursement is ensured. Regarding cystic fibrosis, management stated that the selection of the best next-generation drug will only occur after the results of all candidates are obtained.

Management emphasized that investors building large facilities, including data centers, are ready to commit financially and are willing to sign transmission security agreements. item.title: Fundamentals #0057: Strategy: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
Strategy company (MSTR) revenues in the third quarter of 2026 amounted to 125.43 million USD (−2.5% y/y), while net income increased by 601.4% y/y to the level of 19.53 billion USD.

Quarterly results

What management says

Management emphasized that the company currently possesses a large reserve of credit capacity on the balance sheet, which allows for the creation of a large amount of credit. According to management, the most important goal is the return of the Stretch instrument to its nominal value and its development for the purpose of purchasing bitcoins and increasing the value of common shares. Management indicated that the company can currently issue digital credit instruments, whereas previously it relied mainly on convertible bonds. According to management, the entry of large financial institutions validates bitcoin, which reduces the risk for the entire industry. Management also noted that after the disruption of quotes, all of the company’s credit instruments recovered losses to a similar extent.

item.title: Fundamentals #0051: PACCAR: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
PACCAR (PCAR) revenue in Q3 was 7.94 billion USD (+19.0% y/y), and net income increased by 43.6% y/y to 847.50 million USD.

Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP) was 1.61 USD (+43.8% y/y), which is identical to the earnings per share (GAAP, diluted) result of 1.61 USD (+43.8% y/y).

What management says

Management emphasized closer cooperation with suppliers to ensure parts necessary for truck production. According to management, customers are starting to place orders for next year, which is only the beginning of this process. Management expects further growth in parts sales by the end of the year and gaining market share. According to management, uncertainty should subside, and the market will strengthen over the next year. Management also mentioned that the new PACCAR Connect platform operates like an open system with applications that can generate additional revenue.

item.title: Fundamentals #0050: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) revenue in Q3 was 5.12 billion USD (+36.3% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 18.45 USD (+35.5% y/y).

Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 19.16 USD (+36.0% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) increased by 69.7% y/y to 20.07 USD. The company’s operating income was 2.05 billion USD, representing an increase of 99.5% y/y compared to 1.03 billion USD a year earlier.

What management says

Management emphasized that relations with partner Sanofi are very good, and the cooperation is on a strong track and open to new projects. According to management, the company is open to acquisitions and licenses at every stage of drug development, however, science decides the decisions. Management noted that when comparing external opportunities with their own research department, their own projects are usually selected. According to management, preparations for introducing a new drug for myasthenia are highly advanced. Management also emphasized that when entering new areas, such as obesity treatment, the company aims for solutions that realistically change the situation for patients, rather than just more similar drugs.

item.title: Fundamentals #0047: Monolithic Power Systems: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) revenue in the third quarter was 1.20 billion USD (+63.1% y/y), and earnings per share (adjusted) reached 8.19 USD (+73.2% y/y).

Quarterly results

Gross margin was 55.4% (0.3 pp y/y), while operating income was 357.69 million USD (+83.3% y/y). Earnings per share (GAAP) was 5.51 USD (+47.3% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 5.53 USD (+47.5% y/y).

What management says

Management assesses growth drivers very well, although they indicate it is still too early for next year’s forecast. According to management, notebook sales are weaker due to memory shortages at manufacturers, but in the long term, this market is viewed optimistically thanks to technology and market share. Management emphasized that at the current growth rate, operating costs will come in below the company’s model due to R&D efficiency. According to management, increasing production capacity should not require a large increase in capital expenditures or a change in capital structure. Management also noted that the company is not raising prices, but rather sharing part of the cost increase with customers.

item.title: Fundamentals #0045: Gilead Sciences: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
Gilead Sciences (GILD) revenue in the third quarter was 8.30 billion USD (+6.8% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) fell by 20.2% y/y to 1.94 USD.

Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) was 1.96 USD (−20.3% y/y), while adjusted earnings per share increased by 3.2% y/y to 2.55 USD. Operating income reached 3.46 billion USD (+4.1% y/y), with an operating margin at 41.7% (−1.1 pp y/y).

Management commentary

According to management, the HIV segment benefited from favorable pricing in certain channels and demand, and Biktarvy’s market share continues to grow. Management emphasized that the company is focused on growth in the areas of oncology and inflammatory diseases. According to management, weekly oral HIV prevention is intended to reach individuals who prefer long-acting medications instead of injections. Management indicated that the way drug pricing is established under the IRA act may threaten investments in new products next year. According to management, the impact of new prices primarily concerns the Medicare program and manifests as a spillover effect to other sales channels. Management expressed satisfaction that the company absorbed the costs of newly acquired programs this year and intends to continue this process in the following years.

Management commentary

According to management, demand remains stable, and discussions with customers indicate an improving demand environment. Management emphasized that higher shipment weight allows maintaining stable revenue per unit of weight without fuel, confirming the effectiveness of the pricing policy. Management also indicated that most of the increase in cost per employee results from rising supplemental benefit costs related to inflation in healthcare. According to management, the company has a large reserve of capacity in real estate and equipment, and due to in-house driver training, it does not experience issues with employee recruitment. item.title: Fundamentals #0028: PayPal: 3Q2026 results

What management says

Management emphasized that the goal is to increase Venmo’s significance in customers’ daily finances by developing the current base and expanding the offering with financial services. According to management, financial services constitute a key driver of future transaction margin growth, in which the company intends to continue investing. Management also indicated that AI agent-led commerce is a priority and a great opportunity for the company, based on trust and security. Management also noted that in the area of credit financing, it will maintain a balanced approach between on-balance sheet and off-balance sheet. According to management, the impact of EU de minimis customs duties on trade in Europe will also persist in the next quarter. Management also emphasized that it is open to an objective analysis of options to increase shareholder value, and is currently focusing on the implementation of its own plan.

item.title: Fundamentals #0027: Baker Hughes: 3Q2026 results
item.description:

Quarterly results

What management says

Management emphasized that order growth is driven by enduring trends, such as increasing demand for power generation capacity in the United States related to data centers and investments in gas infrastructure. According to management, order strength is broad, manifesting in growth in power systems and LNG, as well as a growing equipment base supporting service. Management expects revenue growth and EBITDA margin expansion in the following year, noting that margin improvement will not be linear but will result from cost synergies and a more favorable sales mix. According to management, a seasonal decline will occur in the first quarter in subsequent quarters, with a clearer improvement in the second half of the year. At the same time, management is taking a cautious approach to short-term prospects in the Middle East, expecting a weakening of activity in this region.

item.title: Fundamentals #0026: NXP Semiconductors: 3Q2026 results
item.description:

Quarterly results

What management says

Management emphasized that no widespread inventory replenishment is being observed in the automotive sector, with longer lead times improving demand visibility. According to management, confidence in continued growth is based on the increasing adoption of software-defined vehicles and the impact of artificial intelligence on industry and the Internet of Things. Management indicated that the gross margin improvement is structural and results from higher revenues, better fab utilization, and operational efficiency, while price increases merely cover higher costs. According to management, there is a structural shift in pricing within the industry, allowing semiconductors to capture a larger share of value in systems. Management noted that in data centers, growth depends on product launches, their adoption, and software deployment by customers. According to management, the company already has won projects in North America and the Asia-Pacific region, and is also conducting several pilots in China and Europe.

item.title: Fundamentals #0025: Seagate Technology Holdings PLC: 1Q2027 results

Management emphasized that instead of destroying demand, they are observing its increasing creation on a quarter-to-quarter basis. According to management, the slower growth in shipments in the past period was planned well in advance and was not a result of issues during product transitions. Management noted that the pricing strategy remains unchanged, and new contracts incorporate higher costs of external components, which are more than covered by rising prices. According to management, the share buyback will clearly increase from the next quarter, as the company no longer plans further debt repayment activities. Management also indicated that corporate customers and hardware manufacturers are increasingly less likely to fall behind in purchasing the highest-capacity drives.

The company expects fourth quarter revenue in the range of 14.20 billion EUR – 15.20 billion EUR with a gross margin of 57.0%. For the full year 2026, projected revenue is 44.00 billion EUR – 45.00 billion EUR, and gross margin is expected to be 56.0%.

item.title: Fundamentals #0001: PepsiCo: 3Q2026 results
item.description:
PepsiCo (PEP) revenues in the third quarter were 25.27 billion USD (+5.6% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased by 17.4% y/y to a level of 2.23 USD.

Quarterly results

Adjusted earnings per share were 2.34 USD (+2.2% y/y), while revenues in the PFNA segment reached 6.50 billion USD.

Management commentary

According to management, expiring commodity price hedges will cause an increase in costs, which will be partially visible in the next quarter. Management noted that they are not satisfied with results in North America and are considering a revision of the business model and distribution. According to management, the company intends to limit non-growth related expenses to redirect funds toward growth-driving brands, which is expected to bring improvement in subsequent quarters and next year.

item.title: Fundamentals #0000: Definition of F-Logs
item.description:
F-Log is my journal of facts regarding companies from the Nasdaq-100 index. Each quarterly report of a specific company receives a separate entry, while insider transactions and other significant filings go into a collective log.

Data comes exclusively from official company documents, such as filings with the US SEC and investor relations materials. This information is collected and verified by my module operating on a separate server, which aggregates data from official sources.
